subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should first-class group pairing be content-blind until owner approval, or should OpenClaw also support an explicitly configured restricted reader for pending groups?
rationale: The choice defines a new cross-channel authorization and persistence contract, and reader mode changes whether unapproved group content crosses model, plugin, session, transcript, and memory boundaries.

options.title: Content-blind pairing
options.body: Add pending group identity, owner notification, and approve/reject operations without ingesting group content before approval.

options.title: Pairing plus reader mode
options.body: Add an opt-in pending reader only after defining sandbox, tools, hooks, storage, retention, and prompt-injection boundaries.

options.title: Keep explicit allowlists
options.body: Retain current group admission and pursue only narrower warn, notify, or auto-leave behavior in channel-owned paths.

recommendation.title: Content-blind pairing
recommendation.body: Add pending group identity, owner notification, and approve/reject operations without ingesting group content before approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They already routed this exact issue as an unresolved product and security decision and are the clearest available owner for choosing the intended contract.
